name: The Echo Chapel
objective: Infiltrate the Echo Cult's chapel and confront Echo Priest Maltheus about the stolen Frostbells.
intro: The chapel is warm. That is the first wrong thing. Hymns in no living language drift from below the floor.
dialogue: Echo Priest Maltheus: "Child, we are not stealing the bells. We are returning them."
Echo Priest Maltheus (defeated): "You fight for a seal you have never seen. I pity you."
lore_discovery: The cult believes the thing beneath Frostpine is not sealed — it is sleeping, in pain, and the bells are a lullaby. Ringing all six lets it wake gently instead of violently.
